tsconfig.json con strict:true, outDir dist/, moduleResolution NodeNext; npx tsc --noEmit pasa.

tests/test_init.sh y tests/test_upgrade.sh no dependen de jq para parsear JSON.

Harness detail view renders a KPI strip (approval rate, coverage, closures last 14 days) and an inline SVG sparkline (<polyline>, --hw-* tokens only, role=img with aria-label; no chart library).
Docs section lists business/architecture/conventions/verification as quick-view buttons using the existing /api/md docs: mechanism, degrading gracefully when a doc is missing.
Timeline and card dates render relative (e.g. 3d ago) with the absolute date in the title attribute via a small fmt helper.
tests/test_toolbox_serve.sh covers the metrics payload in /api/state; ./init.sh exits 0.

2026-SP5.name: toolbox_theme_toggle
2026-SP5.title: toolBox observer: light/dark/system theme toggle (Plan B)
2026-SP5.description: Port the legacy ux2 6.4 theme contract to the React panel. The CSS tokens already switch on :root[data-theme] and prefers-color-scheme; add the control layer only: synchronous anti-flash inline script in panelHtml() <head>, a 3-state control (light/dark/system) in the nav with aria-pressed, localStorage key hw-theme:1 (system = remove the key), matchMedia listener active only in system mode.
acceptance: panelHtml() head carries a synchronous inline script that reads localStorage hw-theme:1 and sets data-theme on <html> before first paint (no flash).

Nav shows a 3-state theme control (light/dark/system) with aria-pressed reflecting the active state; selecting system removes the storage key and data-theme follows matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') live.
Explicit light/dark persist across reloads via localStorage hw-theme:1; no new hex values, tokens only.
tests/test_toolbox_serve.sh asserts the anti-flash script and theme control markup are served; ./init.sh exits 0.

2026-SP5.name: toolbox_markdown_render
2026-SP5.title: toolBox observer: safe rendered markdown (Plan C)
2026-SP5.description: Replace the raw <pre> markdown viewer with marked + DOMPurify (both served as UMD from node_modules via the existing /vendor/* mechanism; add both as runtime deps). Sanitize with FORBID_TAGS/FORBID_ATTR and javascript: URL blocking; add CSP default-src 'self' on server responses as second defense. Agent-produced markdown is untrusted even though it is local. Applies to the viewer for current/history/checkpoints/backlog/docs and search result excerpts.
acceptance: marked and dompurify are runtime dependencies served via /vendor/marked.js and /vendor/dompurify.js from node_modules UMD builds.

The md viewer renders sanitized HTML: DOMPurify with FORBID_TAGS (at least script,style,iframe,form,input) and FORBID_ATTR (event handlers), javascript: hrefs stripped; a hostile fixture proves script/onerror/javascript: do not survive.
Server responses carry Content-Security-Policy default-src 'self' (allowing inline script/style needed by the panel) as second defense.
Viewer applies to current/history/checkpoints/backlog/docs quick-views; search results keep textContent excerpts.
tests/test_toolbox_serve.sh covers vendor endpoints and the CSP header; ./init.sh exits 0.

2026-SP5.name: toolbox_a11y_live
2026-SP5.title: toolBox observer: a11y live regions + empty states (Plan D)
2026-SP5.description: Two persistent live regions created once at load (polite with role=status, assertive with role=alert), initially empty; SSE updates are queued and summarized with debounce (e.g. '3 features updated in handyman'), never announced per event. SSE connection indicator uses text + color (never color alone). prefers-reduced-motion is consulted before any animation/auto-scroll. Empty states become actionable ('no projects - run handyman install').
acceptance: Exactly two persistent live regions exist from first render (role=status aria-live=polite, role=alert), empty at load, and are the only aria-live surfaces.
SSE-driven changes enqueue and a debounced summary lands in the polite region; connection loss/recovery lands in the assertive region as text (indicator shows text + color, not color alone).
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables panel animations and auto-scroll behaviors.
Empty fleet/harness/search states show an actionable hint instead of a bare dash.
tests/test_toolbox_serve.sh asserts the live-region markup in the served panel; ./init.sh exits 0.

acceptance: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens a native <dialog> palette via showModal(); Esc closes it and focus returns to the previously focused element.
Palette input filters/ranks actions (go to project, go to view, open md, search) using MiniSearch; Enter executes the selected action; j/k or arrows move the selection.
Global shortcuts work (/ focuses search, g+letter navigates views, ? opens help) and are inert while focus is on input/textarea/select or inside the palette input except its own navigation keys.
A single document-level keydown listener implements the shortcuts (no per-component listeners).

2026-SP5.name: toolbox_intake_ui
2026-SP5.title: Vista de intake en el panel: redactar peticion, draft editable y copiar (Plan A)
2026-SP5.description: Vista #/intake en assets/toolbox_panel.js (Plan A de docs/analisis-peticiones-llm-toolbox.md §5): selector de harness destino y proveedor (GET /api/providers), textarea de peticion libre, consumo del SSE de POST /api/draft con render seguro (marked+DOMPurify), draft editable y boton copiar al portapapeles. Errores en live region assertive. El observador sigue sin escribir disco.
acceptance: Vista #/intake con selector de harness y proveedor poblados desde /api/state y /api/providers
El draft llega por SSE y se renderiza sanitizado (DOMPurify); es editable antes de copiar; boton copiar usa clipboard API con fallback
event: error del relay se anuncia en la live region assertive existente
Tests de panel (patron de las suites toolbox existentes) cubren la vista y el flujo copiar; cableados en run_tests.sh
bash tests/run_tests.sh passes

2026-SP5.name: toolbox_intake_enhancements
2026-SP5.title: toolBox observer: intake UI enhancements, file tags, and direct submission
2026-SP5.description: Extiende la vista #/intake (feature 26) con seleccion de archivos del workspace como tags de contexto, y un endpoint de envio directo que persiste el intake en el harness destino. Backend: GET /api/files lista archivos del workspace dentro de roots registradas; POST /api/draft acepta files[] e incluye su contenido en el contexto volatil; POST /api/intake escribe el draft final en $WORKSPACE/feature-request.md (el artefacto de intake que consume el leader). Validacion 4xx de payloads invalidos/vacios sin spawning de procesos.
acceptance: La vista de intake muestra una lista/dropdown buscable de archivos disponibles en el workspace, permitiendo seleccion multiples para incluir como tags de contexto en el prompt.
El usuario puede enviar el intake al harness desde la UI (POST /api/intake) y recibe una notificacion de exito/fallo.
El backend rechaza un payload invalido o vacio con un error HTTP 4xx y no lanza un proceso handyman.
GET /api/files?root= solo resuelve dentro de roots registradas y devuelve rutas relativas; POST /api/draft incluye el contenido de los archivos seleccionados como contexto.
bash tests/run_tests.sh passes

2026-SP5.name: start_and_close_timestamps
2026-SP5.title: Registrar fecha y hora exactas al iniciar/cerrar features y sprints
2026-SP5.description: Almacenar timestamps ISO 8601 al iniciar/cerrar features (meta.started_at/done_at) y al cerrar sprints (closed_at) para enriquecer las metricas de observer.
acceptance: feature.js start registra meta.started_at (ISO 8601)
feature.js done registra meta.done_at (ISO 8601)
sprint.js close incluye el timestamp de cierre (closed_at)
schema feature_list draft-07 compatible con las nuevas claves (meta)
bash tests/run_tests.sh passes
